name: System Monitor
description: Monitor CPU, RAM, GPU, disk, network and battery in 18 themes and 5 layouts — no extra Python packages required
author: PyDeck Team

cpu_monitor.label: CPU
cpu_monitor.description: Live CPU usage, temperature, clock speed and load average

ram_monitor.label: RAM
ram_monitor.description: Live memory usage, with the used / total breakdown and swap

gpu_monitor.label: GPU
gpu_monitor.description: Live GPU utilisation, temperature, VRAM and board power

disk_monitor.label: Disk
disk_monitor.description: Live disk usage for a chosen mount point

net_monitor.label: Network
net_monitor.description: Live download and upload rates for one interface or all of them

battery_monitor.label: Battery
battery_monitor.description: Charge, power draw and estimated time left
